question: When inputs, training structures, model, and update budget are held fixed, does the form in which an exact physics oracle exposes its answer determine what spatial forward-model capability fine-tuning installs, and do verifier scores install the same capability as explicit answers?

key_findings.claim: The supervision target's answer form, rather than label length or output format alone, determines how much spatial physics behavior is learned.
key_findings.evidence: With two-shot format calibration on the shared tier-1 stream, full-ranking supervision reaches 0.733 governing-story localization, peak-scalar supervision 0.467, boolean compliance 0.327, and the untrained base 0.300. The P-versus-A difference is +0.267 with exact paired p<10^-4, while O is not distinguishable from base. A shuffled-ranking placebo reaches 0.353, and a governing-story-only label reaches 0.680, showing that naming the target matters more than raw bit count or ranking syntax.

key_findings.claim: The vector-versus-scalar gap transfers across model family, a structurally isomorphic second physics domain, and a paraphrased evaluation surface, but the scalar rung is setting-dependent.
key_findings.evidence: Ranking supervision yields 0.86-0.91 raw OOD localization across frames/Qwen, heat/Qwen, and frames/Llama, whereas scalar supervision reaches 0.56, 0.29, and 0.11 before calibration. Under calibration, Llama ranking is 0.840 versus scalar 0.247 with 92:3 discordant pairs. Re-rendering held-out frame descriptions changes calibrated P/A/O/base localization only from 0.73/0.47/0.33/0.30 to 0.75/0.44/0.31/0.29.

key_findings.claim: Dense oracle answers and score-filtered imitation install transferable physics behavior, whereas the tested GRPO score updates mostly sharpen in-pool behavior without changing held-out physics.
key_findings.evidence: From the same 0.660 tier-2 starting checkpoint, dense SFT reaches 0.747 forward, 0.713 extrapolation, 0.707 two-step, and 0.693 post-intervention localization; GRPO round 1 reaches 0.667/0.575/0.573/0.573. On fresh n=600 streams pooled over three axes, dense SFT exceeds GRPO round 2 by 0.087 (p=1.7e-14), while headroom-matched GRPO is equivalent to its own start within +/-0.05. Filter-then-imitate reaches 0.753 forward, statistically equivalent to dense SFT.

key_findings.claim: Verifier scores can cheaply route an already installed capability through a new action interface even when they do not install the underlying capability.
key_findings.evidence: The dense-SFT checkpoint localizes the edited description at 0.680 but falls to 0.533 when given the original state plus an action, an interface gap of -0.147. Action-format GRPO raises the action condition to 0.687, exactly matching its paired description condition; action-label SFT reaches 0.760 on the action axis and also improves surrounding behavior.

key_findings.claim: The best text-trained 8B model reaches the same observed tier-2 band as a structured-input specialist, while a frontier model and a hand formula remain materially lower.
key_findings.evidence: On tier-2 forward and post-intervention localization, the final LLM scores 0.733/0.680 and the specialist GNN 0.733/0.680; Opus 4.8 scores 0.500/0.553 and the first-order formula 0.447/0.473. Thirty-two oracle-labeled in-context examples reduce Opus forward localization to 0.433 rather than improving it. Six heterogeneous learners converge in the 0.733-0.780 band, which the authors relate to the top-two drift-margin distribution and roughly +/-8% per-story precision.

method.core_idea: Turn the content exposed by a training objective into a controlled variable by using a deterministic finite-element oracle to generate multiple answer forms over byte-identical structural descriptions.
method.mechanism: OraclePhys generates steel-frame descriptions and exact per-story drift rankings with OpenSees. Seven supervised arms expose a full ordering, peak scalar, pass/fail bit, pointwise value, full value vector, governing-story index, or shuffled placebo. Frozen checkpoints are tested on longer structures, counterfactual strengthening, two edits, extrapolation, paraphrases, and a state-plus-action interface. A second hardened curriculum then compares oracle-written SFT, oracle-score-filtered imitation, and GRPO that receives only scalar ranking rewards, with paired deterministic streams and exact McNemar tests.
assumptions: Synthetic 2-D linear frame mechanics and an isomorphic heat-conduction task are informative model organisms for how objective content affects learned computation.
Behavior on ordinal intervention and extrapolation axes is a valid operational measure of an installed forward model, without implying a particular internal representation.
Byte-identical structure text plus controlled suffixes isolates answer content well enough to support causal comparisons among supervised arms.
The finite-element oracle and parser are correct, and their deterministic streams make paired instance-level tests valid.
The tested Qwen3/Llama 8B LoRA and short-horizon GRPO recipes are representative enough to expose an answers-versus-scores distinction, although not enough for a universal negative claim about RLVR.

techniques.role: Varies which transformation of the same exact oracle solution appears in the label while holding the underlying structure text fixed.
Uses a finite-element solver to grade rankings and counterfactual edits without human labels or model judges.
Prepends identical worked examples to every arm so missing output syntax is separated from missing task behavior.
Strengthens selected stories and asks where the governing response moves, blocking simple replay of the original answer.
Samples candidates, keeps high-scoring oracle-approved answers, and applies dense imitation to separate score provenance from sparse advantage-weighted updates.
Starts GRPO from a weaker checkpoint with enough performance runway to test whether a ceiling explains its null result.
Stores per-instance correctness and uses exact McNemar tests, bootstrap intervals, and powered fresh streams for direct protocol comparisons.

evaluations.setting: Frames tier-1, two-shot format calibration, n=150 paired instances
Second model family on calibrated tier-1 frames
Heat-conduction isomorph, n=150 per main axis
Tier-2, same 0.660 start and hardened pool
Fresh tier-2 streams, n=1800 pooled over forward, two-step, and post-intervention
Tier-2 specialist/frontier comparison, n=150 per axis

limitations: Author-stated: all main training results use 8B models with LoRA; GRPO is limited to at most 800 steps, group sizes up to 50, and learning rates from 10^-6 to 10^-5.
Author-stated: both physics domains are synthetic, and heat conduction mirrors the frame task structurally, so the replication tests recipe robustness rather than broad domain generality.
Author-stated: 'installs a forward model' is only a behavioral claim; linear probes decode the target similarly even from the behaviorally inert boolean arm.
Author-stated: post-edit structures come from a family represented during training, and every reported evaluation axis is ordinal, potentially under-crediting scalar or vector magnitude models.
Author-stated: descriptions use one fixed training template; the paper tests one paraphrased surface but not many-shot prompting or tool use.
Author-stated: K/V/G/S controls are single runs, and failure to reject a difference is not evidence of equivalence except where a bounded TOST-style interval is reported.

Reviewer-identified: the strong conclusion about scores is specific to group-relative policy gradients and this exploration distribution; other RL objectives, curricula, full-parameter updates, or much longer training could behave differently.
failure_modes: A scalar objective can support a shortcut that predicts population priors, format, or aggregate magnitude without localizing the causal spatial feature.
Group-relative rewards vanish on stable-wrong prompts when every sampled answer is similarly wrong, leaving no gradient toward missing knowledge.
An evaluation that requires a ranking can mistake format failure for absent knowledge unless every arm receives a common readout calibration.
Reasoning-channel supervision can impose an installation tax when the bottleneck is missing domain knowledge rather than insufficient deliberation.
Ordinal metrics can miss a real magnitude model learned by scalar or value-vector targets.
Performance can saturate at a data-precision frontier when top responses are separated by margins smaller than label or model estimation error.
reusable_insights: Treat label answer form as an experimental factor: which intermediate variables the target explicitly names can matter more than label entropy or length.
Separate installing knowledge from routing an installed capability through a new interface; a weak scalar signal may be sufficient for the latter but not the former.
Use filter-then-imitate as a provenance control when comparing dense supervision with verifier-scored RL: it keeps the verifier as the only source while changing credit assignment.
Measure transfer on stable-wrong examples and counterfactual edits, not only reward improvement on already solvable training prompts.
Calibrate output form across treatment arms before interpreting task differences as knowledge differences.
Curricula concentrated near decision boundaries can beat simple data-volume scaling when measurement precision sets the effective ceiling.
open_questions: Does a process-level verifier or token-level credit assignment close the answers-versus-scores gap without exposing the complete answer?
Do prolonged RL, full-parameter updates, or substantially larger models eventually install the stable-wrong physics behavior that short-horizon GRPO does not?
Would a direct drift-value prediction axis show that scalar and vector-value arms learned useful magnitude models hidden by ordinal evaluation?
How far does objective-shape control generalize beyond solvable synthetic physics to natural language, software, or partially observed environments?
Can adaptive sampling deliberately create reward variance on stable-wrong prompts while preserving an unbiased training signal?
What internal mechanism distinguishes knowledge installation from interface routing when linear probes cannot?

competitive_landscape.title: SFT Memorizes, RL Generalizes: A Comparative Study of Foundation Model Post-training
competitive_landscape.difference: Chu et al. report stronger OOD generalization from outcome-reward RL than SFT on rule and visual variants. OraclePhys instead holds inputs and oracle fixed, finds dense SFT or filtered imitation transfers while short GRPO does not, and attributes the disagreement to answer content, stable-wrong exploration, and credit assignment rather than a universal SFT/RL ordering.

competitive_landscape.title: Does Reinforcement Learning Really Incentivize Reasoning Capacity in LLMs Beyond the Base Model?
competitive_landscape.difference: Yue et al. infer elicitation by comparing large-k support of base and RL policies on reasoning tasks. OraclePhys creates exact counterfactual targets and direct supervised controls, showing reward can improve its own sampled distribution and route actions without installing measurable held-out physics.

competitive_landscape.title: Spurious Rewards: Rethinking Training Signals in RLVR
competitive_landscape.difference: Shao et al. show that random or otherwise spurious rewards can elicit large math gains in some Qwen models, implicating prior capability. OraclePhys reproduces the prior-amplification concern from a from-scratch GRPO arm but adds an exact oracle, stable-wrong decomposition, and answer-written versus score-only controls.

competitive_landscape.title: Rethinking Generalization in Reasoning SFT: A Conditional Analysis on Optimization, Data, and Model Capability
competitive_landscape.difference: Ren et al. show that reasoning SFT can generalize after sufficient optimization with verified long traces and capable bases. OraclePhys studies a different conditional variable—the exact answer field exposed under byte-identical inputs—and finds a ranking or target index transfers much more than scalar or boolean supervision.

novelty_assessment: Author claim: OraclePhys is the first exactly oracle-graded, byte-controlled study to manipulate the supervision answer form and the verifier's role while probing counterfactual spatial physics. Primary comparisons support that the nearest RL-versus-SFT papers study capability support, generalization, or spurious rewards without this answer-form intervention and exact dense-label control. Reviewer inference: the cleanest novelty is the experimental instrument and the installation-versus-routing dissociation, not a universal theorem that RL cannot add knowledge. The result is compelling within 8B LoRA and short GRPO, but its mechanistic explanation and scale generality remain open.
reviewer_notes: Quantitative claims were checked against page-marked Tables 1-9 and the paired-test descriptions on pages 3-8. Author claims about causal answer form are supported by byte-identical supervised arms and format controls. The term 'world model' is intentionally reported only in the paper's behavioral sense. Competitive records and mechanisms were verified on primary arXiv pages.
